captions.instagram:
Thinking about an LLC? Three things people get wrong about taxes:

✔️ Myth: an LLC cuts your taxes. Fact: a one-owner LLC is taxed like a sole proprietorship by default, on Schedule C, with self-employment tax.
✔️ Myth: you never need an EIN. Fact: the IRS says most new single-member LLCs will need one.
✔️ Myth: an LLC is an S corp. Fact: S corp status is a tax election. An LLC with 2 or more owners is a partnership by default.

An LLC is mainly a legal structure. We form LLCs in all 50 states and explain the tax side.
captions.youtube_description: Myth: an LLC cuts your taxes. Fact: a single-member LLC is taxed like a sole proprietorship by default (Schedule C, self-employment tax). Myth: no EIN needed. Fact: most new single-member LLCs need one. Myth: an LLC is an S corp. Fact: S corp status is an election; multi-member LLCs are partnerships by default.

sources.fact: Single-member LLC is disregarded by default; owner reports on Schedule C; owner pays self-employment tax; can elect corporation treatment with Form 8832; most new single-member LLCs will need an EIN (page updated 27-Jul-2026); read 2026-10-30

A domestic LLC with at least two members is a partnership by default (Form 1065); can elect corporation treatment; an LLC that elected S status files Form 1120-S (page updated 22-Aug-2026); read 2026-10-30
